## OpenUsage for Windows 0.2.1

- Low usage alerts now fire at 50%, 40%, 30%, 20% and 10% remaining, for both the 5h and the weekly window.
- The weekly alert says whether you are on pace to last the week or will run out before it ends.

Download `OpenUsage-windows-x64.exe` and run it. No installer or separate .NET installation is needed.
